root_cause_of_previous_failure.explanation: The MoltCourt __init__ received party_b as a string (hex address from JS SDK) but only handled bytes→Address conversion. The GenVM storage layer requires Address objects with .as_bytes. Fixed by adding isinstance(party_b, str) check before the bytes check.
root_cause_of_previous_failure.fix: Added `if isinstance(party_b, str): party_b = Address(party_b)` to MoltCourt.__init__
